name: gnome-poppler
description: Poppler PDF library built without Qt bindings for GNOME and other GTK stacks. Do not install alongside kde-poppler (same install paths).

user:
cmake -B build -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release   \
      -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr  \
      -D TESTDATADIR=$PWD/build/testfiles \
      -D ENABLE_QT5=OFF             \
      -D ENABLE_QT6=OFF             \
      -D ENABLE_UNSTABLE_API_ABI_HEADERS=ON \
      -G Ninja .
